note: Canonical hardcode class table. Tier uses the Golden vocabulary (MUST/SHOULD/FREE). disposition is how the observation is emitted: violation only where the pinned Golden states the rule directly and the syntax is unambiguous; every other class stays a review candidate because applicability (new/touched/legacy, test scaffold, config-of-record) is not provable from syntax alone. No value classified as HC-SECRET is ever written to a report or ledger; only a masked form and a digest are recorded.

classes.title: Credential material inside a literal
classes.guidance: Move the value to the project secret store or environment configuration and read it through the documented configuration pipeline. Never copy the value into a report, ledger, prompt or memory; only the masked form and its digest are recorded.

classes.title: Environment or service host written into code
classes.guidance: Read the base URL from environment configuration ({NAME}_URL, appsettings or ConfigMap) instead of a literal, and reach services through the gateway key for the selected environment.

classes.title: External map or layer service called directly
classes.guidance: Route external map, layer and geocoding calls through the platform arcgis-proxy entry for the owning application instead of calling the vendor host directly. Confirm the proxy route and the consumer before changing the call site.

classes.title: Absolute external URL inside code
classes.guidance: Decide whether the value is a config-of-record for the application, a test or sample scaffold, or a value that belongs in environment configuration. Accepted test scaffolds are recorded once in the hardcode policy ledger instead of being changed.

classes.title: Environment selector compared as a literal
classes.guidance: Justify the literal against the configuration contract for the environment-specific source (SYSTEM_CONFIG_* selection) before replacing it with a configuration read.

classes.title: Business limit kept as an inline literal
classes.guidance: Justify the literal against the centralized-constants contract, or move it to the constants home for that domain. Timeout, delay, interval and retry values are deliberately out of scope for this class.

classes.title: Host, link or database name written into SQL
classes.guidance: Confirm whether the object must take the value as a parameter or from the environment-specific configuration, and whether the form is legacy evidence that must not be reproduced in new scripts.
